Maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_hero]]heroes[[/col]] an AI army will aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\n[[col:white]]15[[/col]] by default.

Value [[col:yellow]]N[[/co]] that defines a range from which a random percentage is selected and applied to the maximum percentage of each unit type in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe range is from [[col:yellow]]-N[[/co]]% to [[col:yellow]]+N[[/co]]%.\\n[[col:yellow]]N[[/co]] is a multiple of 5.\\n\\nFor example, with an [[col:yellow]]N[[/co]] variation of [[col:white]]15[[/co]]%, a unit category configured with a maximum of [[col:white]]50[[/co]]% will range from [[col:white]]42.5[[/co]]% to [[col:white]]57.5[[/co]]%.\\n\\n[[col:white]]15[[/col]] by default.

Base maximum percentage of [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_artillery]]artillery[[/col]] units an AI army will aim to contain in restricted armies.\\n\\nThe percentage does not take the [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_lord]]lord[[/col]] and [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_hero]]heroes[[/col]] into consideration. A random variation is applied to each army to prevent army compositions from being too similar.\\n\\n[[col:white]]20[[/col]] by default.

Base amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in an army.\\n\\nA unit's [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost is identical to its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Bonus amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/col]]Army Supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units, per level of the commanding [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_lord]]lord[[/col]].\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Enables [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for AI armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nWhen an army is restricted, if the AI attempts to recruit new units in it, some of its existing units are disbanded to remain within the limit.\\nThe AI is reimbursed for the cost of disbanded units.\\n\\nUnits are removed in the following order until [[img:icon_merc]]Army Supplies[[/img]] are no longer exceeded:\\n- Excess [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_hero]]heroes[[/col]] leave the army\\n- The cheapest units in the categories exceeding their maximum percentage are disbanded\\n- Among the cheapest units, the AI disbands up to 1–2 times the number of recruited units. This factor depends on the [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_lord]]lord[[/col]]: some disband more units to field a smaller, elite force, while others disband fewer, resulting in a wider but less elite army\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Base amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in an army.\\n\\nA unit's [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost is identical to its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Bonus amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/col]]Army Supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units, per level of the commanding [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_lord]]lord[[/col]].\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Enables [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for player armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nWhen restricted, the army becomes immobilized until units are either disbanded or transferred to another army.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.
